title: VietMEAgent: Culturally-Aware Few-Shot Multimodal Explanation for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
findings: The proposed VietMEAgent model, which integrates a cultural knowledge base and program-structured reasoning, significantly outperforms general VQA baselines in cultural accuracy. This indicates that specialized, knowledge-grounded models are more effective for reasoning about culturally specific topics, including religious practices like ancestor worship and identifying religious architecture, compared to models without this explicit cultural context.
